summary: An authenticated SVG floor-planning workspace for Lumen Layouts where users create durable plans, place and edit fixtures, undo and redo canvas changes, switch plans, export summaries, and print reports.

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates a plan, edits the SVG workspace, saves it, and reloads durable state

steps.expect: a sign-in panel is visible when no user session exists

steps.action: sign up or sign in with email and password
steps.expect: the workspace shell is visible with the plan list, SVG canvas, fixture library, and inspector
the plan name Lobby Lighting Plan appears as the active plan and the canvas is empty

steps.action: drag a fixture from the library onto the SVG canvas
steps.expect: a fixture appears on the SVG canvas and is selected with a visible selection outline

steps.action: edit the selected fixture in the inspector
steps.expect: the selected fixture visibly moves to the edited position, rotates, and shows brightness 70 in the inspector
the SVG canvas view changes and the zoom indicator displays the updated zoom level
a visible saved status message is shown for Lobby Lighting Plan
Lobby Lighting Plan is still listed as the active plan with the edited fixture and saved viewport restored

acceptance: a saved plan remains visible after a full browser reload
the saved fixture position, rotation, and brightness are restored after reload
the saved canvas pan and zoom are restored after reload

journeys.title: A signed-in user edits a fixture using accessible keyboard alternatives

steps.expect: the previously saved Lobby Lighting Plan is visible with at least one fixture on the SVG canvas

steps.action: move keyboard focus to the fixture on the canvas
steps.expect: the focused fixture is selected and an accessible selection label is visible

steps.action: move the selected fixture with keyboard arrow controls
steps.expect: the fixture position values in the inspector change and the fixture visibly moves on the canvas

steps.action: rotate the selected fixture with keyboard controls
steps.expect: the fixture rotation value changes and the fixture visibly rotates

steps.action: adjust the selected fixture brightness with keyboard controls
steps.expect: the fixture brightness value changes in the inspector
the previous fixture value is restored and the redo control becomes enabled
the fixture value returns to the redone state and the undo control remains enabled

acceptance: canvas fixture selection can be performed without a mouse
keyboard movement changes the same saved fixture data shown in the inspector
undo and redo visibly restore fixture states

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates a second plan and switches between durable plans

steps.expect: Lobby Lighting Plan is visible in the plan list
Conference Room Plan appears as the active plan with an empty canvas

steps.action: add a fixture to the second plan
steps.expect: the second plan canvas shows its own selected fixture

steps.action: switch back to the first plan
steps.expect: Lobby Lighting Plan becomes active and shows its previously saved fixture

steps.action: switch to the second plan again
steps.expect: Conference Room Plan becomes active and shows the fixture added to that plan

acceptance: switching plans changes the visible canvas content
fixtures from one plan are not shown inside another plan
both plan names remain available in the plan list

journeys.title: A signed-in user exports and prints a plan summary report

steps.expect: a report panel is visible with a plan selector

steps.action: select the saved plan for reporting
steps.expect: the report preview shows Lobby Lighting Plan and includes a fixture count
a downloadable plan summary file is produced with the plan name and fixture details
a print-ready summary view is shown containing the plan name, fixture count, and fixture properties

acceptance: the exported summary contains the selected plan name
the exported summary contains fixture position, rotation, and brightness values
the print view contains the same plan summary shown in the report preview

journeys.title: A signed-in user views settings and signs out

steps.expect: the settings page shows the signed-in user's email and a sign-out control
the user is returned to a signed-out screen and workspace content is no longer visible

steps.action: open the workspace route while signed out
steps.expect: the sign-in panel is visible instead of the user's saved plans

acceptance: settings displays the current signed-in identity
signed-out visitors cannot view workspace data

routes.name: Home
routes.purpose: Public landing page for Lumen Layouts with sign-in entry points

routes.name: Workspace
routes.purpose: Authenticated SVG floor-planning workspace with plan list, canvas, fixture library, inspector, undo, redo, save, pan, and zoom controls

routes.name: Library
routes.purpose: Authenticated route showing available draggable fixture types and keyboard instructions for adding fixtures

routes.name: Reports
routes.purpose: Authenticated route for previewing, exporting, and printing plan summaries

routes.name: Settings
routes.purpose: Authenticated route showing account identity and sign-out controls

entities.name: authSession
relationships: an authenticated session owns access to the signed-in user's plan records

entities.name: plan
relationships: a plan belongs to exactly one authenticated user
a plan contains zero or more fixture objects in its fixtures array
each fixture object stores type, x position, y position, rotation, and brightness

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: workspace, library, reports, and settings routes require an authenticated session
a signed-out visitor sees a sign-in panel instead of private plan data
plan records are owned by the signed-in user
one signed-in user cannot view, switch to, export, print, or edit another user's plans

operations.description: Establish an authenticated session using platform auth signUp or signIn with email and password

responsibilities.behavior: use the supplied email and password with the backend SDK auth flow and expose the signed-in email in the application shell

operations.description: End the current platform auth session using auth.signOut

responsibilities.behavior: clear the active platform authentication session and hide authenticated workspace data

operations.description: Persist a new owned floor plan via db.entity('plan').create
Persist edits to the active owned plan via db.entity('plan').update
Restore the previous local plan snapshot and move the current snapshot to the redo stack

responsibilities.behavior: replace current fixtures and viewport-editable state with the most recent undo snapshot and place the replaced state on the redo stack

operations.description: Restore the next redo snapshot and move the current snapshot back to the undo stack

responsibilities.behavior: replace current fixtures and viewport-editable state with the most recent redo snapshot and place the replaced state on the undo stack

operations.description: Generate a downloadable summary file for the selected plan

responsibilities.behavior: build a downloadable text summary containing the plan name, fixture count, and each fixture's type, x position, y position, rotation, and brightness

operations.description: Generate a print-ready summary view for the selected plan

responsibilities.behavior: render a print-ready report containing the selected plan name, fixture count, and each fixture's type, x position, y position, rotation, and brightness

states.loading: sign-in and sign-up buttons show an in-progress state while the backend auth request is pending
states.empty: signed-out visitors see the sign-in panel
states.validation: email must look like an email and password is required
states.error: authentication failed message is visible when sign-in or sign-up fails
states.success: workspace shell is visible after successful authentication

states.loading: plan list and canvas show a loading state while owned plans load
states.empty: no plans yet message is shown with a create plan control
states.validation: plan name is required before creating or saving a plan
states.error: saving failed message is visible if durable persistence fails
states.success: saved status message is visible after a successful save

states.loading: canvas shows loading text while the selected plan is being restored
states.empty: empty canvas message is shown when the active plan has no fixtures
states.validation: fixture brightness must stay between 0 and 100 and zoom must stay within the displayed zoom range
states.error: invalid fixture value message is visible when inspector values are out of range
states.success: selected fixture outline and inspector values reflect the current canvas state

states.loading: report preview shows loading text while the selected plan summary is prepared
states.empty: no report available message is shown when there are no saved plans
states.validation: a plan must be selected before export or print controls run
states.error: export failed or print failed message is visible when the requested output cannot be produced
states.success: download is produced for export and print-ready view is shown for print

states.loading: settings show loading text while the current user is read
states.empty: signed-out users see the authentication prompt
states.error: sign-out failed message is visible if the backend sign-out request fails
states.success: signed-out screen is visible after sign-out

acceptance.statement: a signed-in user can create a named plan and see it as the active plan in the workspace
a saved plan with at least one edited fixture is restored after a full page reload
pan and zoom controls visibly change the SVG canvas viewport and the saved viewport is restored after reload
undo and redo controls visibly restore prior and later fixture states
keyboard alternatives can select and edit a canvas fixture without mouse dragging
switching between two plans changes the visible canvas content to the selected plan's fixtures
exporting a plan produces a downloadable summary containing the selected plan name and fixture details
printing a plan shows a print-ready summary containing the selected plan name and fixture details
after sign-out, private workspace content is hidden and the sign-in panel is shown

deferred.reason: the requested workspace requires authenticated durable personal plans, not simultaneous collaborative editing
the request only requires an in-app SVG floor-planning workspace and export of a plan summary
brightness editing is required as fixture metadata, not physical rendering simulation
